name: frontend-engineering-agent-plugin
description: A persistent frontend engineering agent with project memory, domain memory, feature lifecycles, implementation, and review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Evolve frontend projects with persistent engineering memory.
interface.longDescription: Analyze frontend projects and requirements, design feature implementations, execute approved plans safely, review results, and preserve project, domain, and decision knowledge for future work.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this frontend request and create a feature contract.
Design an implementation plan for this frontend feature.
Review this feature against its contract and project rules.
